definitions.gloss: in large quantities, in bulk, in great amounts
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something involving a large volume or number. Used for physical quantities, production, consumption, and abstract amounts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大量|たいりょう}に⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: To drink water in large quantities.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}に⟦{仕入|しい}れた→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It became cheaper because we purchased in bulk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大量|たいりょう}に⟦{生産|せいさん}している→生産する：01841_seisansuru⟧。
examples.english: This factory produces parts in large quantities every day.

notes:
Emphasizes a large volume or amount of something. The underlying noun ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧ means 'large quantity' and can also be used as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective (⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大量|たいりょう}に⟦{生産|せいさん}する→生産する：01841_seisansuru⟧: to mass-produce
- {大量|たいりょう}に⟦{消費|しょうひ}する→消費する：25230_shouhisuru⟧: to consume in large amounts
- {大量|たいりょう}に⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy in bulk
- {大量|たいりょう}に⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: to occur in large numbers
- {大量|たいりょう}に⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ingest in large quantities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: a lot — more casual and general-purpose
- ⟦{多量|たりょう}→多量：12308_taryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in large amounts — near-synonym; ⟦{多量|たりょう}→多量：12308_taryou⟧ is slightly more formal and often used in scientific contexts
- ⟦{大|おお}いに→大いに：01609_ooini⟧: greatly, very much — describes degree or intensity rather than quantity
